rules: If S-mode is not supported, or if satp.MODE is read-only zero, the implementation may make menvcfg.FIOM read-only zero.
When menvcfg.PBMTE is set to 1, the Svpbmt extension is available for page tables pointed to by satp.
When menvcfg.PBMTE is set to 0, the implementation behaves as though Svpbmt were not implemented for page tables pointed to by satp.
